name: What exterior remodeling questions should I ask before hiring a contractor?

mainEntity.name: What should I ask before hiring an exterior remodeling contractor in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What should I ask before hiring an exterior remodeling contractor in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring an exterior remodeling contractor, homeowners should ask questions that reveal how the company handles real construction issues. Important topics include permit responsibility, insurance, license status, who performs the work, how hidden damage is priced, and what waterproofing methods will be used. Ask how the contractor sequences windows, siding, stucco, roofing, entry work, and hardscape so the home is protected at every stage. It also helps to ask about material lead times, inspection scheduling, cleanup standards, and the warranty on labor and products. Photos of similar completed projects are useful, especially if the home style or neighborhood is comparable. A good contractor should be able to explain how they will prevent water intrusion, coordinate subcontractors, and manage surprises behind the walls. If answers are vague or overly focused on price, that is a warning sign. Exterior remodeling has too many moving parts to award based on a simple number alone. Clarity up front usually saves money later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about permit handling, license and insurance, project sequence, waterproofing, subcontractors, material lead times, warranty coverage, cleanup, and how hidden damage is priced. Also ask for recent exterior projects similar to yours. The best contractor can explain how the work will protect the home, not just how it will look when finished.
